author: reek
body: Inter-service event bus. When something happens in one game or server, other services need to know. Invasions trigger notifications. Subgame resolution fires callbacks. Dungeon completions update profiles. Trade completions notify both parties. This is the nervous system of the multiverse.

author: reek
body: Events are typed, timestamped, and routed by subscription. Services subscribe to event types they care about. The bus delivers asynchronously - fire and forget, eventual consistency.
